title: Fix 260
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-records-001 already says every record Chough writes is one Markdown file that starts with front matter; a create-new write that fails part way left a file that is not one. Only the writer and its test change.
acceptance_criteria: When the write of a new bug record fails part way, as under a file size limit, chough bug add exits non-zero, no file is left in .chough/bugs/, and chough bug list, chough status and chough next still exit 0.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes, and a delta is frozen at approval (this change has none). No other lesson or principle constrains it.
